title: South Coast — Sea Turtles & Mtende Beach
location: South Zanzibar – Sallaam Cave & Mtende Beach
bestTimeToGo: Year-round; June to October for the driest weather
highlights: Swim with wild sea turtles at the natural Sallaam Cave pool
Explore the dramatic cave formations and crystal-clear natural pools
Visit Mtende Beach — one of the most beautiful and unspoilt beaches in southern Zanzibar
Experience the quieter, less-touristed side of the island
Enjoy traditional lunch at a beachside spot
Drive through charming southern fishing villages

itinerary.dayBody: After morning pickup from your hotel, drive south through the island’s interior, passing through picturesque villages and lush tropical forest. Your first stop is Sallaam Cave — a stunning natural cave with a crystal-clear pool where green sea turtles swim freely. Wade into the cool, turquoise water and swim alongside these beautiful creatures in their natural habitat. After the cave experience, continue south to Mtende Beach, widely considered one of the most beautiful and untouched beaches on the island. The powdery white sand stretches endlessly, framed by palm trees and the deep blue Indian Ocean. Enjoy a relaxing traditional lunch at a nearby beach restaurant before spending the afternoon swimming, walking the shore, or simply soaking in the serenity of this remote paradise. Return to your hotel in the late afternoon.

pickupInfo: Complimentary pickup from all major hotel areas in Zanzibar.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour.

seo.title: South Coast Tour – Sea Turtles & Mtende Beach | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Swim with sea turtles at Sallaam Cave and explore the stunning Mtende Beach on Zanzibar’s unspoilt south coast. A full-day adventure off the beaten path.

content:
Zanzibar’s south coast is the island’s best-kept secret — a stretch of raw, untamed beauty that most tourists never see. This full-day tour takes you to two of the south’s most remarkable spots: Sallaam Cave and Mtende Beach.

Sallaam Cave is a natural wonder — a cave opening into a pristine, turquoise pool where wild green sea turtles glide through the water. Swimming alongside these graceful creatures in their natural environment is a truly magical experience. Afterwards, head to Mtende Beach, a stunningly beautiful stretch of white sand on the island’s southern tip. With virtually no development in sight, this is the Zanzibar of postcards and dreams — just sand, sea, palms, and peace.
